stories.headline: Judge rules Pentagon illegally blacklisted Anthropic
stories.blurb: A federal judge ruled the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unconstitutional, ending a monthslong legal battle that started when the Trump administration added the AI lab to a supply chain risk list in March. Anthropic had accused the government of unlawful retaliation.
stories.why_it_matters: Government blacklists can shut AI companies out of federal contracts overnight — and now there's precedent for fighting back.
stories.original_headline: Anthropic was illegally blacklisted by the Trump administration, court rules

stories.headline: GLM-5.3 just went open-weight — China's answer to GPT-4o
stories.blurb: Zai's GLM-5.3, a frontier multimodal model competitive with GPT-4o and Claude 3.5, is now available for download. The weights are freely available on Hugging Face, letting developers run or fine-tune a model that handles text, vision, and voice at state-of-the-art performance.
stories.why_it_matters: Another GPT-4-class model you can run yourself, no API required.

stories.headline: Google's new Gemini model can transcribe speech and understand what it means
stories.blurb: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe doesn't just convert speech to text—it can identify speakers, summarize conversations, and extract action items while transcribing. It's built for meetings, interviews, and any scenario where you need both a transcript and context about what was said.
stories.why_it_matters: Transcription becomes a reasoning task, not just dictation—one API call gets you text plus insights.

stories.headline: xAI's Grok 4.6 is now live on Microsoft's cloud marketplace
stories.blurb: Grok 4.6, xAI's latest model, is now available through Microsoft Foundry — Microsoft's Azure AI marketplace for enterprise customers. This marks the first time Elon Musk's xAI has made Grok accessible outside its own X platform infrastructure, letting Azure customers deploy it alongside models from OpenAI, Meta, and Anthropic.
stories.why_it_matters: xAI is no longer X-only — enterprises can now buy Grok through their existing Microsoft contracts.

stories.headline: NVIDIA just shipped its first CPU built specifically for AI agents
stories.blurb: NVIDIA's Vera CPU is now shipping to customers across the AI ecosystem. Unlike traditional CPUs, Vera was designed from the ground up to run agentic workloads—the kind where AI systems need to think, plan, and act autonomously rather than just process data quickly.
stories.why_it_matters: Hardware optimized for agents could make autonomous AI systems faster and cheaper to run at scale.
stories.original_headline: Delivering Vera: NVIDIA’s First CPU Built for Agents Is Shipping Now

stories.headline: Google's AI notebook can now quiz you on books you've bought
stories.blurb: Gemini Notebook now pulls in books from Google Play so you can ask questions about what you've read, generate study guides, or turn chapters into AI podcasts. It's positioning itself as a reading companion that actually remembers what you own.
stories.why_it_matters: Your digital library just became queryable — no more flipping back to find that passage.
stories.original_headline: Google’s AI note-taking app now allows you to interact with books
